verification.description:
Automatic sign-in stopped because additional verification is required. Do not submit the account and password again.

1. Open [Gree account sign-in]({authorize_url}).
2. Complete the CAPTCHA or other verification and approve access.
3. The browser will redirect to `http://localhost/...`. The page may fail to load; this is expected.
4. Copy the complete address from the browser address bar and paste it below.
